title: LCARS Project Intensity v1
description: Structural schema for a per-project intensity.json (template: priv/cap_profile/canon/config/intensity-template.json). The LEVEL is the HUMAN's declaration (elicited by the framing interview — stakes of failure, lifetime; an agent NEVER self-assesses criticality) relayed by the architect; justification carries the WHY in prose. pipeline_default names the validation card. Naming a card IS a declaration: a card chosen without a level records the level as ABSENT (optional here) — never fabricated, never inferred from the card's matrix (that would be the runtime self-assessing). Underscore-prefixed keys are informational and ignored by the runtime.

nature.description: Optional project domain hint (e.g. web-gui, hardware, generic) — informs card selection at declaration time; the runtime only reads pipeline_default.

max_fan.description: Workflow_runs this PROJECT may hold in flight at once. Absent = the fleet default (:fleet_pilot, :max_fan / --max-fan). The ceiling 15 mirrors Admission.max_fan_ceiling/0, which is the authority; the contracts check `intensity.max_fan_ceiling` refuses a divergence.
